narrative.recommendations_md: Post-reorg organizations don’t buy “big bang transformation.” They need targeted scope, early validation, and reusable functional components. LPL under Rich Steinmeier’s enterprise mandate needs quick wins that rebuild organizational confidence, demonstrate execution capability, and create platform foundations that scale beyond pilot. The following three 90-day Proof of Value sprints are designed to deliver exactly that.
